safety_contract.scope: The self-contained src-lesson12 stack only; the Lesson 11 reference pipeline is never changed.
safety_contract.rule: Activate at most one scenario at a time and reset it before the next team receives the environment.

scenarios.bound: one unknown-schema record on an isolated topic
120 source updates while Connect is paused; never a disk-fill exercise
12 source rows snapshotted and restored through compensating CDC updates
40 one-row inserts followed by one explicit OPTIMIZE FINAL on the classroom table
128 KiB sample on a separate 1 MiB-capped topic
